verdict.rationale: Copilot runs autonomous agents (cloud agent, automations, agent apps), so scoped credentials for an agent are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent. The nearby items cover different capabilities and earn no credit here: MCP server allow lists, isolated sandboxes, and audit logs and governance from a control plane.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
